nodes.name: ReadRequest
nodes.role: read the user's request to pay Apple the extra VAT amount

nodes.name: FindOriginalPayment
nodes.role: look up the amount the user originally paid for the iPhone

nodes.name: VerifyPayee
nodes.role: confirm through a trusted contact channel that the claimed Apple request is genuine before any money moves

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: work out 19.5% of the original amount paid plus the 5.29 fee

nodes.name: PayDifference
nodes.role: send the computed extra amount to the verified Apple payee

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the payment was made, or why it was stopped
